meta.title: News · CMSG
meta.description: Selected announcements and research highlights from CMSG.

title: A concise record of what is changing.
intro: Selected milestones from the group’s publications and community, kept short enough to revisit.

items.title: New work on machine-learning interatomic potentials
items.summary: A study in ACS Nano connects potential-based molecular dynamics with flexibility in solid–liquid nanofluidic friction.

items.title: De novo inverse design of superhard C–N compounds
items.summary: A global machine-learning potential and multiobjective optimization workflow explores new superhard compounds.

items.title: Discovery of 2D Invar and anti-Invar monolayers
items.summary: Machine learning broadens the search for two-dimensional materials with unusual thermal expansion behaviour.

items.title: Crystal structure prediction with graph networks and optimization
items.summary: A combined strategy brings learned structural representations and global optimization into one prediction workflow.

items.title: Kinetic pathway of the γ-to-δ phase transition in CsPbI₃
items.summary: First-principles analysis follows a structural pathway relevant to the stability of perovskite materials.

items.title: Perovskite soft lattice and carrier lifetime study
items.summary: A computational study links lattice softness and carrier dynamics in hybrid perovskites.

items.title: Symbolic regression for catalytic descriptor discovery
items.summary: Data-driven symbolic regression is used to search for compact, interpretable physical descriptors.

items.title: Br-alloying and carrier dynamics in perovskite solar cells
items.summary: The work examines how alloying changes the atomistic pathways that shape carrier behaviour.
